venue.name: Heritage Acres
venue.description: Heritage Acres is the Saanich Historical Artefacts Society's outdoor heritage site in Saanichton, home to the 9,000 sq. ft. Willard Michell museum building and around a dozen relocated or replica heritage buildings, including the restored Saanichton schoolhouse, a blacksmith shop, a print shop, a carpentry shop, a sawmill, a planer mill, a log cabin, a country chapel and the Newman Boat House on a pond. Old vehicles, tractors and equipment of all kinds are spread across the property, and trails wind through the woods past several picnic areas. The Vancouver Island Model Engineers share the site and give the public rides on their miniature railway on published dates, always by donation. The site's own pages appear not to have been updated for some years: the listed events and train run dates are from 2018 and 2019.

facility_notes.lunch_space: There are a number of trails that wind their way through the property and several nice picnic areas.

venue.seasonal_notes: The miniature train rides are listed as available from May to October, but the published run dates on the site are the 2018/2019 season and the booking note tells visitors to contact VIME 'starting February 2019'.

programs.name: Group visit
programs.description: A visit to the Heritage Acres site: the museum building, the heritage buildings and the machinery collection, with trails and picnic areas through the woods. The restored Saanichton schoolhouse has one room refitted to show what the classroom originally looked like, and the rest of that building is available for group meetings and receptions. No admission price, opening hours, group rate, school programme or booking process is published on the site; the only admission figures found anywhere on it are gate prices on an expired 2018 event page, which have not been recorded here as current.
programs.what_children_do: Walk the trails between the heritage buildings and picnic areas, look at tractors, steam and gas engines, old cars and a retired transit bus, a sawmill, a blacksmith shop and a boat house of marine artifacts, and step inside the restored one-room schoolhouse and the log cabin.
programs.our_note: Everything here rests on a phone call: the website has not been refreshed since about 2018, so treat its hours, prices and event dates as out of date and ring 250.652.5522 first. Ask specifically whether the buildings will be unlocked on the day you want and whether anyone will be demonstrating the blacksmith shop or sawmill, because on an ordinary day the site is mostly a walk among static machinery. It is outdoors and spread out, with no rain shelter mentioned.
programs.practical_summary: Trails and several picnic areas on site, so an outdoor lunch works. Admission price, opening hours, washrooms, rain backup, bus parking and stroller or wheelchair access are not stated anywhere on the site.
programs.evidence: the rest of the building is available for group meetings and receptions

programs.name: Miniature train rides
programs.description: The Vancouver Island Model Engineers (VIME) operate a miniature railway on the Heritage Acres site and give rides to the public on published dates. All VIME train rides are by donation, whether or not there is a gate charge that day. The Heritage Acres page says the rides are available from May to October, but the published run dates on it are the 2018/2019 season. VIME also hires the trains out for private events such as birthday parties; that booking is handled on VIME's own site, which was not opened.
programs.what_children_do: Ride the miniature train around the site's track on a day the model engineers are running it.
programs.our_note: Do not promise this to a group without confirming: the trains only run on VIME's published days and the schedule shown here is years out of date. Rides are by donation rather than a set fare, so bring cash, and check who to speak to about a group of children arriving at once.
programs.practical_summary: Rides by donation, outdoors, on published days that the site says run May to October. Capacity, minimum age, and whether a group can reserve a slot are not stated.
programs.extra_fees_note: ALL VIME train rides are by DONATION, whether or not there is a gate charge.
programs.evidence: ALL VIME train rides are by DONATION, whether or not there is a gate charge.
